policy: Read-only research conversions. Assumptions travel with values; no XDF export is enabled.

nominal_xt_timer.status: service-correlated nominal; not measured on this ECU
nominal_xt_timer.basis: TSCR2=5 gives bus/32. Fan diagnostic repeats every 250 tasks; each task is 4*2500 timer ticks. Yamaha specifies a 5-second fan cycle with 2 seconds on, 3 off.

nominal_xt_crank.status: conditional: 11 capture intervals including one double interval interpreted as one crank revolution
nominal_xt_crank.basis: Counter wraps at 11; gap interval is halved; A44 sums six normalized pitches; A36 contains three. Rotor-to-crank and TDC phase require independent confirmation.

dwell_ms.meaning: base dwell contribution; additional dwell and speed clamps still apply

injector_compensation_ms.meaning: additive injector-duration compensation after lookup rounding

speed_rpm.meaning: ideal speed-coordinate scale; reciprocal truncation, saturation and stale-state handling are separate

spark_relative_degrees.meaning: relative scheduler angle, NOT absolute degrees BTDC; fixed and variable timer corrections follow

q8_gain_percent.meaning: dimensionless multiplier of the stated contribution, not necessarily total fuel

fuel_iat_gain_percent.meaning: IAT factor in the normal fuel chain; integer rounding occurs in the actual multi-stage calculation

transient_iat_gain_percent.meaning: factor in transient contribution; not the same scaling as normal IAT correction

normalization_gain_percent.meaning: multiplicative factor in the denominator, not a direct fuel multiplier

temperature.status: conflicted; not assigned to map axes
temperature.support: Fits IAT fault replacement 80 to 20 C; stock thermistor curves and manual resistance points admit approximately 2.7 kohm IAT and 1.8 kohm coolant pullups.
temperature.conflict: Coolant fallback 144 would be 60 C; XT660 service manual specifies 80 C. Diagnostic payload is floor(raw*160/256), capped at 149, and does not establish the display offset.

supply.status: hypothesis; not assigned to map axes
supply.support: Would make fault replacement 154 approximately 12 V and dwell-axis knots approximately 6.5 to 16.5 V.
supply.conflict: Analog divider and dashboard decode are absent; diagnostic payload floor(raw*256/240) is not proven to be decivolts.

pressure.status: service-correlated hypothesis; not assigned to load axes
pressure.support: Assuming diagnostic payload units of 0.5 kPa agrees with approximately 3.6 V at atmospheric pressure on a 5 V ADC.
pressure.conflict: Dashboard scale and reference voltage unverified. C90 is a processed load coordinate, not direct manifold pressure.

throttle.status: service-correlated hypothesis; not assigned to map axes
throttle.support: ADC ten-bit count minus learned baseline is shifted left 6. Diagnostic angle ranges suggest ADC counts/8 degrees.
throttle.conflict: Dashboard conversion and mechanical sensor geometry unverified. Relative closed angle is not percent throttle.
